_meta.source_note: Limits given by the user from current Amazon rules (title limit effective 2026-07-27). Not independently verified on Amazon pages.
_meta.corroborated_by: US and UK feed templates (Data Definitions, item_name / title_differentiation): 'Item Highlight ... will appear only when the item name is under 75 characters. Do not repeat information already in the item name.'
_meta.precedence: The Product Type rule in the feed template / Seller Central for the chosen marketplace always wins over this file. Re-check with references/live-research.md when older than 90 days.

title.media_note: Media categories (books, music, video) keep up to 200 characters.
title.all_caps: only the brand name may be ALL CAPS
title.over_limit_effect: Amazon may shorten or rewrite an over-limit title automatically.

item_highlights.style: feature / benefit phrases separated by commas, not full sentences; indexed like the title

bullets.max_chars_note: Some categories accept up to 500; the Product Type rule decides.
bullets.indexed_total_note: About 1000 bytes across all five bullets are indexed for search; text beyond that is not indexed.
bullets.forbidden: emoji, check marks, asterisks and similar symbols; no punctuation at the end of a bullet
bullets.mobile_note: The first 60-80 characters of each bullet are what mobile shoppers see before 'Read more'.

description.format: plain text; HTML tags are not supported (a line-break tag is the only tolerated exception)
description.a_plus_note: With Brand Registry, A+ Content takes priority over the plain description.

backend.bytes_note: Latin ASCII = 1 byte per character; Cyrillic, Arabic, CJK and accented letters take 2-4 bytes. One byte over the limit makes Amazon ignore the whole field.
backend.separator: spaces only; commas are wasted bytes and not allowed
